/* ---------- #1/#12 progress (local + export/import) ---------- */
const SP_KEY='amlbase_suite_progress_v1';
function spGet(){try{return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(SP_KEY)||'{}')||{};}catch(e){return {};}}
function spSave(p){try{p.updated=new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10);localStorage.setItem(SP_KEY,JSON.stringify(p));}catch(e){}}
function spSet(fn){var p=spGet();fn(p);spSave(p);}
function spMark(cat,key){spSet(function(p){p[cat]=p[cat]||{};p[cat][key]=true;});}
function spPct(){var p=spGet();var pts=0,max=8;
 if(p.c360&&Object.keys(p.c360).length>=3)pts++;
 if(p.paths&&Object.values(p.paths).some(function(x){return x&&x.done;}))pts++;
 if(p.capstone&&p.capstone.done)pts++;
 if(p.writing&&p.writing.done)pts++;
 if(p.rfi&&p.rfi.done)pts++;
 if(p.redflags)pts++;
 if(p.exam!=null)pts++;
 if(p.effect!=null)pts++;
 return Math.round(pts/max*100);}

function buildSearchIndex(){var ix=[];
 TOOLMETA.forEach(function(x){ix.push({t:'Tool',n:x.n,d:x.d,go:function(){openTool(x.id);}});});
 C360.forEach(function(e){ix.push({t:'Case',n:e.name,d:e.headline,go:function(){S.view='c360';S.selEnt=e.id;S.lens='kyc';render();}});});
 PATHS.forEach(function(p){ix.push({t:'Path',n:p.n,d:p.d,go:function(){S.view='paths';S.pathSel=p.id;render();}});});
 RFLIB.forEach(function(f){ix.push({t:'Red flag',n:f[0],d:f[1]+' \u00b7 '+f[2],go:function(){S.view='redflags';S.rl={q:f[0].slice(0,18),ty:''};render();}});});
 AFC_TYP.forEach(function(x){ix.push({t:'Typology',n:x.n,d:x.d,go:function(){S.view='afc';render();}});});
 return ix;}

function openTool(id){S.view='tool';S.toolId=id;render();}
function renderTool(){
 const t=TM_BY[S.toolId];const data=TOOLS[S.toolId];
 const m=$('#main');
 m.innerHTML=`<div id="toolview"><div class="tvbar"><b>${esc(t.n)}</b><span class="badge b-slate">${esc(t.g)}</span><span class="sp"></span><button data-newtab>\u2197 Open in new tab</button><button data-backsuite>\u2190 Back to suite</button></div><div class="loading" id="tload">Loading ${esc(t.n)}\u2026 (first load of a large tool can take a moment)</div></div>`;
 $('[data-backsuite]').onclick=()=>{S.view='overview';cleanupBlob();render();};
 setTimeout(()=>{
   cleanupBlob();
   try{
     const bytes=Uint8Array.from(atob(data.b64),c=>c.charCodeAt(0));
     _blob=URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([bytes],{type:'text/html'}));
     const tv=$('#toolview');const ld=$('#tload');if(ld)ld.remove();
     const f=document.createElement('iframe');f.className='toolif';f.src=_blob;f.title=t.n;tv.appendChild(f);
     const nt=$('[data-newtab]');if(nt)nt.onclick=()=>window.open(_blob,'_blank');
   }catch(err){const ld=$('#tload');if(ld)ld.textContent='Could not load this tool: '+err.message;}
 },30);
}
